class.name: UniversalControllerListItem
class.brief_description: Resource representing a single position in a [TrainUniversalController].
class.description: [UniversalControllerListItem] defines the behavior for a specific position of a train's universal controller, mapping it to traction percentages and pneumatic brake settings. Its index within [member TrainUniversalController.positions] corresponds to the position number in the [code]UCList[/code] configuration.

members.member: [code]UCList:ReturnPosition[/code] The position index to which the controller automatically bounces back.
[code]UCList:SpeedDown[/code] The speed at which the target value decreases.
[code]UCList:SpeedUp[/code] The speed at which the target value increases.
[code]UCList:MaxCtrlVal[/code] The maximum percentage value for this position.
[code]UCList:MinCtrlVal[/code] The minimum percentage value for this position.
[code]UCList:PrevPosFastDec[/code] The nearest stable position index when moving downwards.
[code]UCList:NextPosFastInc[/code] The nearest stable position index when moving upwards.
[code]UCList:mode[/code] The pneumatic brake position index associated with this universal controller position.
[code]UCList:SetCtrlVal[/code] The target percentage value the controller aims to reach at this position.
